CRYPTO NEWS — August 10, 2026

Market holding a delicate balance today. BTC +0.50% (US$ 65,194), ETH +0.30% (US$ 1,924.85), SOL pulling ahead at +0.70% (US$ 76.91). Fear & Greed dipped 1 point to 30—we're in Fear, not panic. The 7-day momentum is healthier (4.20–6.00% across majors), but overnight action screams consolidation, not conviction. Funding rates across all three majors are flatlined and low: BTC 0.0091%, ETH 0.0052%, SOL 0.0089%. No leverage buildup in either direction. Thermometer reads 46/100 (neutral). This is a waiting-room market—structurally balanced, no overbought or oversold extremes. Stablecoins sitting fat at US$ 255.2B in circulation. The question today isn't direction; it's what happens when the consolidation breaks.

TODAY'S HIGHLIGHTS

BIP-110 Mandatory Signaling Goes Live—Chain Split Risk Real
The mandatory signaling period for BIP-110 went live on August 8, 2026. It would limit how much arbitrary data a transaction can carry for a one-year trial period. Because miner support has stayed in the low single digits, activation is not guaranteed and a chain split may be possible. If a minority chain appears this weekend, buyers could replay signed fork-coin sales on bitcoin itself, making doing nothing the safest move until the chains can be separated. For traders: this is governance theater with real execution risk. Ordinals and BRC-20 players are watching hard. Custody, exchange listings, and wallet support haven't announced fork positions yet. If you hold BTC directly, lock it down until the dust settles. If you're running leverage on major venues, understand they'll probably follow the majority chain post-split, but that's not guaranteed. Execution risk is live.

BitMEX Delisting Quarter of Major Futures Contracts Today at Noon UTC
On 10 August 2026 at 12:00 UTC, BitMEX will delist and settle the XRPU26, ADAU26, ETHU26 and XBTUSDTU26 Futures contracts. This date is nearly three weeks earlier than the original timeline, as the exchange moves toward an operational wind-down. From Aug. 26, BitMEX will enter a close-only mode, barring the opening of any new positions. The platform will use adjusted indexes with final rates determined by time-weighted average prices (TWAP) as of Aug. 6. For traders: if you're holding open positions in these contracts, you have hours to close them or accept forced settlement on a 4-day-old price. No late negotiation. This marks the final chapter of BitMEX's 11-year derivatives reign. Liquidity will evaporate fast once word spreads. Close positions now or face settlement slippage.

Cardano Hits Critical ETF Milestone—Grayscale ADA ETF Under SEC Review
Cardano's ETF story reaches a milestone on August 9, when CME's ADA futures complete the six-month regulated trading window required under the SEC's streamlined ETF framework. Grayscale's ADA ETF application is already under SEC review, with October 23, 2026 cited as the expected decision deadline. Completing the futures requirement doesn't guarantee approval — surveillance, trading depth, and ADA's regulatory classification still matter. For traders: this is structural, not price catalytic. ADA has bled 53% YTD and governance chaos is real. The ETF clock ticking isn't a signal to pile in—it's a reminder that approval odds depend on network health and SEC political will, both uncertain. Watch the October decision, but don't chase illiquidity on this alone.

WATCH LIST

BTC needs to break conviction above US$ 65,363 (24h high) to signal real buy pressure, or snap lower toward US$ 64,500 (support risk). Ethereum holding the US$ 1,934.33 ceiling. ETH inflows holding steady week-to-week, a bullish structural note. Watch Fear & Greed—if it drops another 5–10 points, we're in capitulation territory. Stablecoin velocity and 24-48h volume on US equity open (CPI data rolling) will move the macro dial faster than any on-chain metric. BitMEX wind-down dust will settle Wednesday; watch for liquidity migration to Bybit, Deribit, and OKX. BIP-110 chain split outcome unknown until block lockup finishes late August—custody announcements will come last, not first.

See you tomorrow — stay sharp, hedge your fork risk, and close BitMEX positions before noon UTC.
